summary: A checkpoint no longer drops a seat's last turn: the harness.observed rule also keeps each incarnation's newest working and newest ended observation

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change.

rules.detail: Rules version 25: harness.observed keeps at most two more claims per incarnation, its newest working and newest ended observation, which readers of a seat's last turn ask for (when it began, whether the seat worked after a nudge, whether it moved on after a denial). The rules digest changes, so members agree on a checkpoint only once they all run this build; until then, a member on the new rules waits instead of sealing with older peers.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. Checkpoints already trimmed keep what they dropped.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: later checkpoints use version 24 again.
